title: Villa Piedra, 4 bedrooms in the heart of Puntas
description: In the heart of Puntas, Rincon, your whole group will be comfortable in this spacious and unique space! This home has bedrooms on three levels for privacy when you need it and the main living space right in the middle when you’re ready to gather, enjoy the views, and the pool!The spaceOn the famous 413 Road to Happiness, you will find Villa Piedra. A perfect home for families, friends and large groups. A four bedroom, four story home, two kitchens, 4 full baths, 2 half baths, a salt water pool, and an ocean view. This home offers a large house feel with rooms spread out to provide privacy when needed. The top floor is where you’ll find the master bedroom and a large patio. The Master bedroom has a very comfortable king bed, 2 small closets, and an incredible ocean and sky view. This room has a master bathroom with a bathtub, stand alone shower, and a double sink vanity. The patio can be accessed by all while still offering privacy to those staying in the master. The patio has outdoor furniture, a hammock, and has been used for work outs and yoga practice. On the second level which is the main entrance level is the living room, dining room, and large fully equipped kitchen offering a wolf gas range and subzero refrigerator. There is a wonderful ocean view looking out of the wall of sliding glass doors which open to offer a beautiful tropical breeze. Off of the kitchen is two half bathrooms, the salt water pool and another deck with a large table for outdoor dining. There is outdoor furniture to enjoy your morning coffee while watching the sun rise or to watch the moon rise in the evening!Walking down the stairs from the top floor is the two bedroom level, one with a queen sized bed and the other with a queen sized bed and a twin bed. Each room overlooks beautiful tropical trees and gives a jungle feel. Each room has its own bathroom. This level also has an accessible washer and dryer and its own outdoor deck space.Continuing down to the bottom level is the studio complete with a queen sized bed, a kitchen with two mini refrigerators and a small gas range, as well as a beautiful bathroom with a bathtub. You’ll even have your own private garden, jungle view and parking! @villapiedrarinconGuest accessThe whole house.Other things to noteVilla Piedra is a private place. However, there are neighbors that live full time in the area. We ask that you please be respectful with noise after 10PM. No loud karaoke, or sound systems. We want you to enjoy yourselves but not at the expense of our neighbors peace. We really appreciate your consideration!Let us know if you are looking for a surf coach or a private Chef experience. We know the best guys in town. We can get you in touch to make your experience more memorable! It is understood that many flights get in late (or early in the morning) from Aguadilla. Check in time is 3PM. Guests are welcome to check in at any time they arrive after 3PM on their check-in day. Please be aware that if your flight gets in at 1AM and you want to check in at 2-3AM, you will need to book the night prior to reserve the room. You will be able to let yourself in with the keypad. We have a Pack N Play for children that can be found in the closet of the ocean side two bedroom level room.

description: New A/C unit ! Bright, colorful, guesthouse villa designed for two guest only/1bed+1sofa bed. Quiet, local neighborhood - 10 minute walk to the happening restaurant and bar scene of Puntas and some of Rincón's best beaches for both swimming, surfing and snorkeling: Sandy Beach, Parking Lots, Pools , and others ( Puntas have steep hills if you are in good shape is an easy walk otherwise a car will be best !).Only 10 minute drive to town square , 5 min to Calipso , Maria’s & Domes beach .The spaceVilla Eva is a 430 square foot studio - one queen bed with a curtain divider -one couch bed and fully equipped kitchen . The bathroom of this Villa is specially decorated with historic tiles of Puerto Rico to create and art piece designed by owner who’s an artist living in between Miami and Puerto Rico’s fascinating nature to make Villa Eva a space that inspires beauty, relaxation, and happiness! .The back patio overlooks the nature that surrounds the Villa.Guest accessThis guesthouse villa is located on the same property as the main house on which the property owner, Eva - lives. Located on a safe, quiet, dead end street. The Villa is fenced, and it has space inside for one guest vehicle to park. In order to ensure an early check in you must book from the previous night upon your arrival.House is not suitable for children or pets.Other things to notePuerto Rico is home to a tropical little frog called the "Coqui" - although small in size the Coqui is known for their night time "singing" - bright little chirps that sound like their namesake. To most people it's a beautifully soothing sound of the Caribbean. Weather is unpredictable in the islands and sometimes we lose water and power service although they are reinstated quickly we are prepared with two backup water cistern (645 gallons) . The villa does come supplied with an emergency backup light and battery fans .When water rationing is affecting our neighborhood in Puntas and we have to use the water reserve cistern, the water heater will not work when the water reserve is being used.If you are planning to drink water from faucet please make sure to boil the water first .This Villa was planned with love and creativity. I wanted to make sure to have art and color all around it to blend in with nature. It has that “beachy”layback feel of Rincon where I grew up. The combination of this place reflects in a way that it will definitely make you feel on vacation mode!

description: BRAND NEW SAFE, QUIET & CLEAN 3-2 RINCON HOME CLOSE TO EVERYTHING.WE KNOW RINCON. WE CHOSE THIS LOCATION FOR A REASON. FIND OUT WHY IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD SECTION BELOW.Why stay in an expensive, old, musty condo with unstable utilities in the noisy, crowded tourist zoo of Puntas or Sandy Beach when you can stay in a brand new, spacious home for less that is very close to all the fun, yet far from the crowds? The more that you know Rincon, the more that you'll love our home's location.The spaceTHIS IS NOT YOUR TYPICAL RENTAL. This is a spacious, happy, brand new, clean, pest free home with all the comforts, amenities, storage space, stable utilities and covered parking because we live here part time too. Plus, we’ve worked as senior executives in hospitality for decades, so we know what it takes to make your stay pleasant and memorable, and we are committed to making it so. For example:YOU’LL SLEEP WELL: Our home has powerful AC units in ALL ROOMS including every bedroom. Each bedroom contains oversized beds (king in the master bedroom, queen in 2nd bedroom, twin and full in the 3rd bedroom and wooden, stable crib and mattress for the little one) with double pillowtop mattresses accompanied by extra pillows/blankets and 800+ count cotton sheets so that you'll sleep in comfort. Plus, our home is in a cozy, friendly, safe, quiet neighborhood away from all the 24-7 noise pollution of the tourist corridor. We’ve even included both blackout shades AND blackout curtains in the bedrooms so that you can sleep whenever you want.YOU’LL DINE WELL FOR LESS: Dining out is nice for part of your vacation, but it gets expensive fast. Our home has an outside BBQ grill and fully equipped kitchen with all the appliances, cooking utensils, kitchenware, silverware, condiments, etc. that you need, including a full-sized refrigerator, microwave, full stove, coffee maker, blender, and toaster. Plus, our dining area comfortably fits up to six, full-sized adults. We also provide an adjustable, stable highchair for kids up to age 3. The grocery store is three minutes away.YOU’LL RELAX IN COMFORT: Our home includes an airconditioned, full-sized living area with large, comfortable couch and oversized chair where you can relax in comfort and surf the web via high-speed internet access throughout the entire home or watch your favorite TV show or movie on our 65”, smart HDTV with surround sound and Netflix. Plus, all of the windows in the living area, dining area, and kitchen contain blackout shades for your privacy. Or you can read your favorite book secluded in our private yard while relaxing in our large hammock for two in or out of the sun underneath our oversized umbrella that you can rotate as the sun moves. YOU CAN BRING ALL YOUR STUFF OR YOU CAN PACK LIGHT. PLUS, YOU WON’T NEED TO WORRY ABOUT PARKING: We know how annoying it becomes to have to step over all your belongings in tight quarters. You won’t have to worry about that in our home. Bring all that you want on your trip. Our home can accommodate it. Each of the bedrooms contains a full closet with hangers and oversized dressers for all your clothes. We also provide you with a large safe for all your valuables. Plus, you can store your extra gear (surfboards, dive equipment, etc.) in our oversized laundry and storage room with a door that locks. Or you can pack light and still enjoy your stay, as you have constant access to the home’s full-size washer and dryer with laundry detergent. Also, parking is never an issue. The home contains a connected, covered carport along with private parking for up to three additional cars.YOU’LL BE READY IF WORK CALLS: We hope that you can totally unplug during your vacation, but if work calls, you can respond. Our home contains a workspace with wrap around desk, comfortable high-backed executive chair, large monitor to which you can connect your laptop computer, and wireless color printer/scanner so that nobody needs to know that you’re on vacation unless you want them to.STABLE UTILITIES, THANK GOD! Nothing ruins a vacation faster than no AC, internet, and/or water, and parts of Rincon (e.g. Puntas, Sandy Beach or up the hill away from the beach) are notorious for these utility outages. Fortunately, our home does not experience this. While utility outages can happen anywhere, such outages tend to be infrequent and short-lived in the area in which our home is situated. This is because our home is located two blocks from the beach just behind the sports complex near a school and other municipal buildings and within five minutes from downtown Rincon where the municipality has invested in additional infrastructure to better ensure stable utilities.YOU ARE MOST WELCOME IN OUR HOME: We’ve named our home Your Endless Summer for a reason, and we believe that you’ll understand why during your stay. We know that your vacation time spent with family and friends is priceless and that you’ll expend a lot of money and effort to get here. We also know that there are other places in Rincon that you can choose to host your stay, so we want to explicitly thank you for your interest in our home. We love our home and believe that you will too, in part because we are committed to ensuring that happens. Thank you again, you are most welcome in our home.Guest accessYou will have 24-7 access to the entire home, covered private parking and private yard. We value our guests' comfort and privacy. The home is easy to access. It is single-story with a minimal slope from street to the front door, double doors for both front and carport access, the living area has ample space to move around, and the hallway is wide. The bedrooms are spacious, and access to both bathrooms and showers is easy. Again, we live here part-time and value our comfort and convenience, and we know that you do too.Other things to noteWhile we don’t have room to do it here, after you book, we can plug you into all the best vendors to use, shopping, restaurants and bakeries to visit, convenient store locations, etc. for however you would like to spend your vacation, including the best beaches, snorkeling, surf locations, surf instruction or guide, scuba diving, parasailing, horseback riding, waterfalls, hiking, bioluminescent bays, rappelling, skydiving and more. Our goal is to provide you with as much information as we can to make your stay memorable.

This 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath magnificent home is located on the canal with private beach access to the most beautiful swimming beach that Rincon has to offer, has a swim-up pool bar with Flat Screen TVs, (2) outdoor restrooms, (3) hot & cold outdoor showers, back up power and water reserves, there are too many amenities to list !!!!.Guest accessThis property is a spacious 2,300 sq ft, 4 bedroom, 3.5 ba., Private Villa, that will sleep up to 10 guests in 2 kings, 2 queens, 2 twin bunks and features, Oceanview Panoramic Windows in the living area, gourmet kitchen w/ granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, (5) flat screen TVs, a downstairs handicapped accessible master bedroom with custom tile features, 2 upstairs bedrooms with (3) breathtaking Ocean view balconies, custom Brazilian hardwood doors and a stunning Ocean View Den that acts as a 4th semi private bedroom with air conditioning & ceiling fans in every room throughout the Villa ...Other things to noteThis fantastic property is available for rent daily with a 3 day min., our rates are determined on the number of guests and start at $575 per night for 1-6 guests, additional guests are $50 per person per night, up to 10 guests max, depending on the seasons & are subject to change. The grounds are available for Weddings, Special Events, Corporate gatherings, B-Days, Sweet 15 Parties, etc. of up to 100 guests maximum !!! Event pricing starts at $875 per night for 1-10 guests !!!Instant bookings are not accepted for Events ! a special offer will be sent to you for your approval ! PLEASE NOTE A CONTRACT IS REQUIRED TO BOOK THIS VILLA !!!(the owner will send out a contract & a confirmation letter directly to the guest, the executed contract must be returned to the owner a.s.a.p. !! ) a $200 security deposit may be required !We welcome you to our beautiful property to enjoy your vacation in a Tropical Caribbean Paradise designed just for you !!!
